entities.name: Luis Héctor Villalba
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Luis Héctor Villalba is an Argentine prelate of the Roman Catholic Church who was the Archbishop of Tucumán from 1999 to 2011. He was an auxiliary bishop of Buenos Aires from 1984 to 1991 and bishop of San Martin from 1991 to 1999.
